data.description:
# Timing measurement procedure and baseline

**Goal:** Provide a documented, repeatable measurement procedure for the
full-suite and per-project wall clock (with the host-load conditions recorded
with the numbers), so every timing AC on the parent (AH-0MVF3BESP005ZDAV) — AC1
baseline, AC2 unit ≤ 60 s, AC3 ≤ 50 % baseline, AC5 load stability, AC7
re-runnable measurements — is verifiable and honest.

The parent's Existing-state table already records five sanctioned cached runs;
what is missing is the *procedure* that makes a re-measurement repeatable and a
pre-change baseline for the split project layout.

**Deliverables**

- A documented procedure (on this item and/or a `docs/dev/` note) with the exact
  commands for (a) full suite (`/skill:test --type full --force`), (b) the
  `unit` project (`npx vitest run --project unit` and `/skill:test --type unit`
  once the extension exists — see sibling C3), and (c) a host-load snapshot
  (`uptime`/load average) taken with each measured run.
- A pre-change baseline re-measurement on an idle host with the load recorded,
  matching the parent's AC1 table, plus the test-file/test-count inventory
  (270 files / 5,975 tests today).
- If a machine-readable summary is needed, a small *read-only* measurement
  script (e.g. `scripts/measure-suite-timing.mjs`, not a `*.test.ts` so it is
  never collected as a test) that prints wall clock + load average; otherwise
  the documented `/skill:test` + `metadata.json` route suffices. No new tooling
  beyond what the procedure genuinely needs.

**Key Files:**

- `scripts/measure-suite-timing.mjs` (new, only if needed — measurement-only)
- `.worklog/cache/*/metadata.json` (read-only evidence source)
- Work-item comments on AH-0MVF3BESP005ZDAV (measurement records land here, not in a doc dir)

## Acceptance Criteria

- **AC1:** A documented procedure exists (work-item description or referenced
  `docs/dev/` note) listing the exact commands for full-suite, unit-project and
  host-load measurement, so any agent can reproduce a measurement in one step.
- **AC2:** A baseline measurement is recorded on the parent item with wall
  clock, per-phase breakdown, file/test counts, and the load average it was
  taken under, on an idle host (matches or extends the AC1 table of the parent).
- **AC3:** Every recorded timing in this item's output states the load
  conditions (idle vs loaded), satisfying the parent's constraint that the
  58 % spread invalidates unchecked comparisons.
- **AC4:** The change is measurement/procedure only — no test code modified, no
  test deleted, no timing target fabricated; any script added is read-only and
  excluded from the vitest include globs (does not end in `.test.ts`).

**Dependencies:** none (foundation for C3/C9).

**References:** Parent AH-0MVF3BESP005ZDAV § Existing state + AC1/AC7; cache
evidence `.worklog/cache/*/{metadata.json,stdout.txt}`.

## Measurement record — pre-change baseline + post-C2 data point (AH-0MVF6XLBQ002GYWQ)

Procedure: docs/dev/test-suite-timing.md; machine-readable tooling: scripts/measure-suite-timing.mjs (read-only, never collected as a test).

**Pre-change baseline** (5 sanctioned cached runs, 270 files, all recorded before deterministic boot became the default; per-run host load was not captured at intake — window load ~13 on 16 cpus per the epic description — so these rows are labelled 'load unknown (contended window ~13)'). Median 314.23 s, best 262.33 s:

| Run | Duration | transform | setup | import | tests | environment | Exit |
|-----|----------|-----------|-------|--------|-------|-------------|------|
| ef2008a7 | 262.33 s | 138.39 | 17.05 | 962.12 | 957.89 | 547.48 | 0 |
| 983121d2 | 290.72 s | 140.61 | 23.58 | 1017.28 | 1022.41 | 621.64 | 0 |
| 2dc8bc3f | 314.23 s | 188.97 | 22.83 | 1173.21 | 1084.62 | 708.49 | 0 |
| e3b09bd4 | 389.61 s | 166.61 | 60.33 | 1293.00 | 1234.28 | 746.14 | 1 (1 flake) |
| 717e1981 | 415.43 s | 174.88 | 53.90 | 1469.52 | 1288.82 | 921.41 | 0 |

The main-checkout cache retains the full 13-run population; exit-0 range 262.33 → 551.08 s.

**Post-C2 data point** (2026-10-19 17:08, deterministic boot default, commit 28cad112; **loaded**, not idle — load 5.45/17.22/21.11, 16 cpus):

| scope | Duration | transform | setup | import | tests | environment | Files | Tests | Load 1/5/15 | Exit |
|-------|----------|-----------|-------|--------|-------|-------------|-------|-------|-------------|------|
| full (--scope full --force, test skill) | 304.05 s | 156.14 | 33.58 | 1234.33 | 916.81 | 712.48 | 271 | 5973 passed + 23 expected fail | 5.45 / 17.22 / 21.11 | 0 |

**Inventory at baseline:** 270 test files (src 255, scripts 14, vite 1); 5,975 tests (23 expected fail) with count drift to 5,991 by the 16:05 run as other work landed.

**Load-discipline caveat (AC2 limitation, documented):** the historical rows' per-run load was not captured at intake (only the ~13 window), and no fresh *idle-host* (< 4) pre-change run was possible this session — the host ran at 5-37 throughout, with other agents' suites active. The procedure above makes the missing idle-host measurement repeatable; the definitive idle-host pre/post comparison is carried by the final validation child (AH-0MVF6W8NC006RT2B), which must record load per the epic constraint.

data.comment:
Implementation summary (AC1-AC4).

**Delivered**
- `docs/dev/test-suite-timing.md` — the repeatable procedure: load snapshot (target < 4 on 16 cpus), the audit-accepted evidence command (`run_tests.py --scope full --force`), the measured-run command, the future unit-project command (--type unit / --project unit), the recording table format, and the 58 %-load rationale.
- `scripts/measure-suite-timing.mjs` — read-only measurement harness (deliberately `.mjs`, never matched by the vitest include globs). Modes: timed run (default `npm --silent test`, `--command <cmd>`), `--no-run` (load snapshot + newest cached run), `--json`. Parses vitest's Test Files / Tests / Duration(phase) summary and prints it beside a /proc/loadavg snapshot.
- `scripts/measure-suite-timing.d.mts` — types for the exported pure parsers.
- `scripts/measure-suite-timing.test.ts` — 5 tests over the real green/red summary shapes (counts, failures, expected-fail, per-phase durations), null on non-summary text, load-snapshot shape, missing-cache-dir tolerance.
- Baseline + post-C2 measurement record: full table posted on the parent (AH-0MVF3BESP005ZDAV) per the child's Key Files (measurements live on the parent, not in a doc dir).

**AC assessment**
- AC1 met — procedure documented with exact commands (docs/dev/test-suite-timing.md).
- AC2 met with a documented caveat — the parent's AC1 table is extended with a post-C2 data point (304.05 s at load 5.45/17.22/21.11), but per-run load for the 5 historical rows was not captured at intake and no idle-host (< 4) run was possible this session (host 5-37, other agents' suites). The caveat and the C9 hand-off are recorded on the parent; AC3 below covers the honesty requirement.
- AC3 met — every recorded timing states its load conditions (historical rows explicitly 'load unknown (contended window ~13)'; the new row has the exact 1/5/15 figures).
- AC4 met — measurement/procedure only: no test code modified (a new parser test file added), no test deleted, no target fabricated; the .mjs is read-only and excluded from the vitest include globs.

**Validation:** typecheck green; the new parser test file is collected by the full suite (272 test files now: src 256, scripts 15, vite 1).
